# prompt-compressor

> Deterministic prompt compression that keeps instructions, code and entities byte-exact, removes filler and redundant context, and reports token savings per rule Python package `trysac-prompt-compressor`, import name `prompt_compressor`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
